lens: Information and discoverability; keyboard-oriented use (simulated AI acceptance lens)
reason: The public proposition, distinct client/student actions, engagement terms, preparation guidance and evaluation criteria are clear in source. Desktop hero and full mobile captures show coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy, restrained color and useful process labels. I traced the client journey from services and native FAQ disclosures to the labeled inquiry form and its confirmation, and the student journey to materials and evaluation guidance. The supplied Chromium log confirms those synthetic checks passed; contact delivery was intercepted. Skip navigation, native controls, menu Escape/focus return, pressed-state buttons and live readouts support keyboard use in source. Complete public metadata, private noindex defaults and request-time project/image resolution are credible local improvements. However, the recruitment outage message misstates publication facts. Broad world-class agreement remains unproven without keyboard-only journey evidence, hosted integration or observed user success. Hold for the concrete information correction and focused verification; this is an independent AI assessment, not human endorsement.

findings.evidence: fetchPublicRecruitment destructures only data from the RPC and returns {cycle:null} for a null result, discarding error. JoinPage defaults missing events to [] and unconditionally says “The Board has not published events for this cycle yet” when the array is empty. A failed RPC therefore produces a factual unpublished-events claim without evidence.
findings.userImpact: A prospective applicant checking dates during a service outage can conclude no events exist and defer action. The separate “dates are not available” heading does not correct the more specific assertion below it.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve an explicit unavailable result from the public recruitment loader. Render neutral load-failure guidance with a board contact/retry path, reserving unpublished-event wording for a successful empty response. Verify error, genuinely empty and populated states with focused tests.

notVerified: No shared browser or test execution was performed. Most supplied public journey actions use click/fill, with programmatic focus plus Escape for the menu. Full Tab/Shift+Tab order, skip-link landing, Enter/Space FAQ activation, focus visibility beneath the sticky header and keyboard-only submission/recovery remain unobserved.
No staging or hosted Clerk/Supabase/storage/email integration, actual inquiry delivery, physical-device, Safari/Firefox or assistive-technology acceptance exists in this evidence.

Publication proof uses synthetic HTTP content and verifies new page/images plus page withdrawal; it does not establish hosted approval enforcement, crawler/social-cache removal, or image withdrawal behavior after external caching. Current static case-study fallback is empty, and no approved artifacts/outcomes are supplied.

Board approval of original-resume policy and current factual content, real operator/student/client task success, formal accessibility conformance and measured discoverability gains remain unknown. Resume copy correctly discloses identifying PDF access; it is not anonymization.
